meta.name: archify
meta.description: Create polished, validated architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle/state diagrams as explorable standalone HTML with inline SVG, dark/light themes, optional trace motion, and PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG/WebM export. Accept plain-language requirements or pasted Mermaid flowchart, sequenceDiagram, and stateDiagram input; inspect repository evidence when the diagram must reflect real code. Use when the user asks to visualize system architecture, infrastructure, cloud/security/network topology, technical workflows, API call sequences, request lifecycles, data pipelines, ETL/ELT, data lineage, state machines, or to convert/beautify Mermaid.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把系统结构与流程变成清晰直观的图表
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 需要把系统结构画出来给团队评审或留档。
copy.tagline_en: Turn system structures and flows into clear diagrams
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to visualize system structure for team review or documentation.

howto.what: 它会根据你的描述生成架构、工作流、时序、数据流或生命周期图，产出可交互的独立 HTML（内联 SVG），带浅色/深色主题，可导出 PNG、SVG、WebM 等格式；也能把你粘贴的 Mermaid 图转成同样样式。
howto.when: 当你要求可视化系统架构、API 调用时序、状态机等，或想把 Mermaid 图转换、美化时触发；需要贴合真实代码时它会去查看仓库。

say.text: 帮我画一张这个系统的架构图
say.note: 生成可交互 HTML 图并自动校验

say.text: 把这段 Mermaid sequenceDiagram 转成好看的图
say.note: 读取拓扑后重新绘制，不照搬原样式

say.text: 画一下订单状态的流转和重试
say.note: 输出 lifecycle 生命周期图

howto.what_en: It generates architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, or lifecycle diagrams from your description, output as interactive standalone HTML with inline SVG, dark/light themes, and PNG/SVG/WebM export. It also converts pasted Mermaid diagrams.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to visualize system architecture, API call sequences, state machines, or similar, or to convert or beautify a Mermaid diagram. It may inspect repository evidence when the diagram must match real code.

say_en.text: Draw an architecture diagram of this system
say_en.note: Produces a validated interactive HTML diagram

say_en.text: Turn this Mermaid sequenceDiagram into a polished diagram
say_en.note: Redraws topology instead of copying Mermaid styling

say_en.text: Show the order state transitions and retries
